articles.summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. announced it has entered into an agreement for the full notice to proceed on a $2.4 billion project with Base Electron, backed by Applied Digital, advancing the November 2025 limited notice to proceed for 1.2 GW of efficient natural gas technology for AI Factory campuses. The company also announced its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year 2025.
articles.title: Babcock & Wilcox Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
